name: Cybercore
summary: The aesthetic leans into an ethereal, slightly melancholic mood.
description:
The aesthetic leans into an ethereal, slightly melancholic mood. Standard color palettes rely on highly saturated blues, deep purples, and metallic silvers, usually combined with imagery of angels, flip phones, butterflies, and celestial objects. Rather than copying mainstream 2000s pop culture, Cybercore treats early online life with heavy nostalgia, creating a highly edited version of the past.

Because the terminology overlaps, "Cybercore" is occasionally used as a generic synonym for actual Y2K . To prevent confusion, this article specifically documents the modern visual style that developed its own separate identity on Pinterest and TikTok during the 2020s.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Nostalgia, digital escapism, retro-futurism, ethereal and melancholic moods

visualDNA.colour: Saturated blue, silver, white, with pink and pastel accents
